title: 第05章 游到天涯的鱼

content_zh:
早有一些得到消息的狱卒赶来，那几个刑部差官一走，看牢门的老牛便走到叶小天身边，这老牛五十出头，与叶小天他爹曾经做过多年的搭裆，叶小天忙唤了一声：“牛叔。”
老牛点点头，对叶小天道：“你家的事儿，我听说了。小天呐，你是个孝顺孩子，温和善良、孝顺父母、尊敬长辈，说起来呢，什么都好。就是有时候啊，性子有点……驴了吧唧的。”
叶小天笑得像个腼腆的大姑娘，看不出一点驴的样子。
老牛继续谆谆教诲道：“当然啦，你现在年岁渐长，很久不曾犯驴了，不过这出门在外，可不比咱这牢里头，你在外边要当心些，逢人只说三分话，不可全抛一片心。有什么气儿不顺的事儿，也不要耍驴，啊？”
叶小天客客气气地道：“老牛叔你说的对，小天一定不耍驴。”
“嗯，嗯嗯。”
老牛“嗯”声未了，就被一号监的一群狱卒给拱到一边去了，两个身材高大的狱卒一左一右搭住了叶小天的肩膀，牛头马面似的拥着他往外走。
其中一个狱卒道：“头儿，你要出远门儿倒没啥，咱们兄弟是不担心的。就凭你那心眼儿，你能忽悠的别人心甘情愿跳粪坑都觉得你是为他好，咋可能被人欺负了……”
叶小天佯怒道：“胡说！我有那么黑吗？”
众狱卒异口同声地道：“黑！真黑！黑的伸手不见五指啊！”
叶小天：“……”
一个狱卒正色道：“头儿，你黑起来固然是真黑，可你好起来那也是真好。你为人仗义，有担当，咱们哥们儿打心眼里服你。你这一走，兄弟们都挺舍不得的，让咱们兄弟给你饯个行吧。”
叶小天心中微微有些感动，他站住脚步，转身朝向众人，拱手道：“各位兄弟，好意我心领了。明日事，今日做；今日事，马上做。既然要走，又何必婆婆妈妈，我今日就要离京，饯行酒就不喝了，我等着喝兄弟们的接风酒。”
众狱卒情知他还要去见司狱官，有些事情交结，见他已经安排了行程，却也不再挽留，便纷纷站住脚步，向叶小天拱手道别。
“头儿，一路顺风啊！”
“头儿，早去早回啊！”
有那促狭的狱卒，顺手就把一根木棒塞到了叶小天手里。
叶小天诧然道：“这是？”
那狱卒笑道：“头儿，你要是在外边混不下去了，这根棍子可以用来讨饭打狗。”
众狱卒大笑起来，叶小天也不禁笑骂道：“滚你的蛋！我叶小天在天牢这小天下能混得风生水起，到了大天下一样能八面威风。等着吧，不得一场大富贵，我叶小天就不回来！”

“好！有志气！”
“要得，硬是要得！”
“头儿，我们就等你衣锦还乡啦！”
“头儿说的是，走到哪儿，咱玄字一号监的人也是能人！”
叶小天环视着每一张熟悉的面孔，脸上的笑容渐渐敛去，凝视良久，叶小天霍然一转身，走出几步，微微一停，举手向身后的人们用力扬了扬，又攥成拳头当空一击，便向司狱官刘勇的签押房大步走去。
※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※
司狱官刘勇的签押房里，刘司狱坐在案后，微微蹙着眉，听叶小安向他说明来意。叶小安怯懦老实，一见刘司狱眉头微蹙，官威十足，心中紧张，更觉得气儿不够用了，说话也更加结巴起来，听得刘司狱更加不悦。
其实叶家只要有个男丁来当狱卒就行，谁来当差却没有必须的要求，这种事儿不难办，刘司狱也没理由反对。只是小安过于木讷，远不及他兄弟小天伶俐机警，是以刘司狱甚为不喜。
待见叶小天进来，刘司狱便毫不客气地对叶小安道：“你先出去，我有话和你兄弟说。”
“嗳！”
叶小安憨厚地笑笑，回身看到叶小天，便向弟弟笑笑，神色中有些感激、又有些难为情，叶小天亲切地拍了拍大哥的肩膀，在刘司狱面前远没有他那般拘谨。
叶小安轻轻走出去，又小意儿地把门地带上。
房门一关，刘司狱便紧紧蹙起了眉头，对叶小天道：“你爹老糊涂了不成？小安这孩子那么老实，到了这种地方还有不吃亏的，他能做什么事？是不是你爹逼你让位子，你说，本官替你做主。”

content_en:
Some jailers who had received the news had already arrived. As soon as the officials from the Ministry of Punishment left, Lao Niu, who was guarding the cell door, walked up to Ye Xiaotian. This old Niu was in his early fifties and had been hooking up with Ye Xiaotian's father for many years. Ye Xiaotian hurriedly called out: "Uncle Niu."
Lao Niu nodded and said to Ye Xiaotian: "I've heard about your family's affairs. My dear, you are a filial child, gentle and kind, filial to your parents, and respectful to your elders. Speaking of which, everything is good. It's just that sometimes, your temper is a bit... asshole."
Ye Xiaotian smiled like a shy girl, without looking like a donkey at all.
Lao Niu continued to teach earnestly: "Of course, you are getting older now, and you haven't done anything wrong for a long time. But it's better to be outside than in prison. You have to be more careful outside. You should only speak a few words to people when you meet them, and don't take it all in your heart. If you have any troubles, don't be a donkey, ah?"
Ye Xiaotian said politely: "Uncle Niu, you are right, Xiaotian will definitely not act like a donkey."
"Yeah, uh-huh."
Before Lao Niu could say "Hmm", he was pushed aside by a group of guards in Prison No. 1. Two tall guards put their hands on Ye Xiaotian's shoulders, and hugged him out like a bull's head and a horse's face.
One of the jailors said: "Boss, it's okay for you to travel far away. We brothers don't have to worry. With your mind, you can fool others into thinking you are doing it for their own good. How could you be bullied..."
Ye Xiaotian pretended to be angry and said: "Nonsense! Am I that dark?"
All the jailers said in unison: "Black! It's so dark! It's so dark that you can't even see your fingers!"
Ye Xiaotian: "..."
A jailer said sternly: "Boss, you are really bad when you are bad, but it is also great when you are good. You are a righteous and responsible person, and we brothers admire you from the bottom of our hearts. When you leave, the brothers are very reluctant to leave. Let us brothers give you a farewell."
Ye Xiaotian was slightly moved in his heart. He stopped, turned around and faced everyone, cupping his hands and saying: "Brothers, I appreciate your kindness. Do tomorrow's things today; do today's things right away. Since I have to leave, why bother with my mother-in-law? I will leave Beijing today, so I won't drink the farewell wine. I'm waiting to drink the wine to welcome the wind from my brothers."
The jailers knew that he had to go to see the warden to discuss some matters. Seeing that he had already arranged the trip, but they no longer wanted to stay, they all stopped and said goodbye to Ye Xiaotian.
"Boss, have a nice trip!"
"Boss, go early and come back early!"
The narrow-minded jailer conveniently thrust a wooden stick into Ye Xiaotian's hand.
Ye Xiaotian said in surprise: "Is this?"
The jailer smiled and said: "Boss, if you can't survive outside, this stick can be used to beg for food and beat dogs."
All the jailers burst out laughing, and Ye Xiaotian couldn't help laughing and scolding: "Get the hell out of here! I, Ye Xiaotian, can thrive in the small world of Tianyao, and I can be all-powerful in the big world. Just wait, I, Ye Xiaotian, won't come back until I get rich!"
"Okay! Be ambitious!"
"I want it, I insist on it!"
"Boss, we are waiting for you to return home in fine clothes!"
"What the boss said is that no matter where you go, the people in Prison No. 1 Xuanzi are also capable people!"
Ye Xiaotian looked around at every familiar face, and the smile on his face gradually faded. After staring for a long time, Ye Xiaotian suddenly turned around, walked a few steps, paused slightly, raised his hand to the people behind him, clenched his fist and punched it in the air, then strode towards the prison room where the prison officer Liu Yong was staying.
※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※
In the custody room of Prison Officer Liu Yong, Prison Officer Liu was sitting behind the case, frowning slightly, listening to Ye Xiaoan explain his purpose of coming. Ye Xiaoan was timid and honest. When he saw Liu Siyu frowning slightly and showing his official authority, he felt nervous and felt that he was not angry enough. He stuttered even more, which made Liu Siyu even more unhappy.Joy.
In fact, the Ye family only needs one male to be the jailer, but there are no necessary requirements for who should be the errand. This kind of thing is not difficult to handle, and Liu Siyu has no reason to object. It's just that Xiao An is too dull and far less smart and alert than his brother Xiao Tian, ​​so Liu Siyuan is very unhappy.
When Ye Xiaotian came in, Liu Siyu said to Ye Xiaoan unceremoniously: "You go out first, I have something to tell your brother."
"Hey!"
Ye Xiaoan smiled honestly, turned around and saw Ye Xiaotian, and smiled at his younger brother. His expression was a little grateful and a little embarrassed. Ye Xiaotian patted his eldest brother's shoulder affectionately. He was far less reserved in front of Liu Siyu.
Ye Xiaoan walked out gently and carefully closed the door.
As soon as the door was closed, Liu Siyu frowned tightly and said to Ye Xiaotian: "Is your father confused? Xiao An is such an honest child, and there is no one who will suffer in a place like this. What can he do? Did your father force you to give up your seat? Tell me, I will make the decision for you."
